_comment: Maximums for scripts/size_report.py (ADR-0042). Each is about 15 percent above the number measured on 2026-10-24 (after the lazy Map and the minified editor, IND-186, IND-214, IND-215). The graph limits were set on 2026-11-04 from the measured lazy module (IND-245, ADR-0048) and re-measured after the focus window (IND-246: 14.7 KB raw, 6.3 KB gzip); python_source_bytes was raised to 600000 for the Graph component, then to 660000 on 2026-11-21 for Timeline, Graph styles and Graph frames (ADR-0053; 630,872 measured with the Timeline alone, 4 KB left before it). A pull request that needs more room raises a limit here, in the same diff, and says why in its description and the CHANGELOG. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. The graph limits were then raised to 21000 raw and 8800 gzip on 2026-11-22 for element styles, a stable layout, update keep and frames (ADR-0053; 17,781 and 7,507 measured with styles alone). On 2026-11-25 python_source_bytes rose to 725000, wheel_bytes to 672000 and sdist_bytes to 1985000 for the Kubernetes peer forwarder (IND-209: forward.py is 14.5 KB, plus the forward endpoint and doctor facts; 707,373 measured), after shared limits (IND-213, 8.8 KB) had used the last of the room.
